interpretations: Count matched Laboratory records by sex, considering only non-null sexes with at least one record. Return sexes whose counts exceed the mean of those sex counts; show each count, its fraction of all matched records, and the unrounded count difference from the mean.

Count matched Laboratory records by sex, treating null sex as its own group. Compare each group with the mean count across all groups, and show its count, fraction of all matched records, and unrounded count difference.

Count matched Laboratory records by sex, including sexes recorded for patients with no laboratory records as zero-count groups when calculating the mean. Show qualifying sexes’ counts, fractions of all matched records, and unrounded count differences.

Count matched Laboratory records by sex, excluding null sex from the breakdown but including records with null sex in the total used for each sex’s share. Compare non-null sex counts with their mean and show the unrounded count differences.

Count matched Laboratory records by sex and compare each count with the mean count per sex; calculate each qualifying sex’s share against all Laboratory records, including records with no matching patient, and show the unrounded count difference.

Count matched Laboratory records by sex and compare each count with the mean count per sex; show each qualifying sex’s count, share of matched records, and unrounded percentage by which its count exceeds the mean.
Count matched Laboratory records by non-null sex; calculate each qualifying sex’s share using only matched records with non-null sex, and show its unrounded count difference from the mean.
Express each qualifying sex’s share of the total as an unrounded percentage rather than a fraction.
queries:
WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
summary AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count,
           SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT sc.SEX,
       sc.record_count,
       sc.record_count * 1.0 / s.total_count AS fraction,
       sc.record_count - s.mean_count AS difference_from_mean
FROM sex_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN summary AS s
WHERE sc.record_count > s.mean_count

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    record_count,
    1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS fraction,
    record_count - AVG(record_count) OVER () AS count_difference
FROM counts;

WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(l.ID) AS record_count
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
summary AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count,
           SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT s.SEX,
       s.record_count,
       1.0 * s.record_count / summary.total_count AS fraction,
       s.record_count - summary.mean_count AS count_difference
FROM sex_counts AS s
CROSS JOIN summary
WHERE s.record_count > summary.mean_count

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM counts
),
mean_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_record_count
    FROM counts
    WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.SEX,
    c.record_count,
    1.0 * c.record_count / t.total_count AS share,
    c.record_count - m.mean_record_count AS count_difference
FROM counts AS c
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m
WHERE c.SEX IS NOT NULL

WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS laboratory_count
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
mean_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(laboratory_count) AS mean_laboratory_count
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT
    s.SEX,
    s.laboratory_count,
    m.mean_laboratory_count,
    1.0 * s.laboratory_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory) AS share_of_all_laboratory_records,
    s.laboratory_count - m.mean_laboratory_count AS count_difference
FROM sex_counts AS s
CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m
WHERE s.laboratory_count > m.mean_laboratory_count

WITH counts_by_sex AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
summary AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count,
           SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM counts_by_sex
)
SELECT c.SEX,
       c.record_count,
       1.0 * c.record_count / s.total_count AS share_of_matched_records,
       100.0 * (c.record_count - s.mean_count) / s.mean_count AS percent_above_mean
FROM counts_by_sex AS c
CROSS JOIN summary AS s
WHERE c.record_count > s.mean_count
